name: THE FOUNDATION👁️
desc:
This game is a fan-made game taking place in the universe of DOORS as a fan made continuation from Floor 1.
Explore the hotel's foundation, after being stopped from falling all the way down to the mines by a mysterious force...

A "unique" horror game involving... even more doors.

❗Recommended to play without any help or guide, this game is a process of trial and error; use each death as a lesson, you'll make it through.

⚠️ Epilepsy, sound, and flashing lights!
🎧 Headphones recommended
📸 Max graphics recommended

⚒️ Many things are subject to change, and some things may break.

All credits can be found in-game.
Inspired by nicorocks5555's Rooms, Spooky's Jumpscare Mansion, Portal 2, Little Nightmares, and LSplash's DOORS 👁️
